blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. A shared blend-aware color refinement network with only 44.7K parameters refines an analytic color update to realize either color mapping without rendering. It preserves geometry and delivers standard 3DGS assets in seconds. We also design the ReTouch3D benchmark to support the evaluation of aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer across viewpoints. Experiments demonstrate high color accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenes in both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 11 ] enables photorealistic reconstruction and real-time rendering of reusable scene assets.
As these assets support immersive viewing and visual creation, their aesthetic appeal becomes increasingly important.
Adjusting a scene’s exposure, color balance, and tone can improve its overall aesthetic presentation.
Therefore, creators need tools that automatically enhance scene colors or transfer preferred colors and tones from an edited view, with consistent results across viewpoints ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
3D高斯平板(3DGS)[11]可以进行光现实化重建并实时渲染可再使用的场景资产.
由于这些资产支持沉浸式取景和视觉创作,其审美吸引力变得越来越重要.
调整场景的曝光度,色彩平衡和声调,可以改善整体美学表现.
因此,创作者需要能够自动增强场景颜色或从被编辑的视图中传输首选颜色和花言巧语的工具,并有一致的跨视角结果(图1).

blocks.en:
In 2D photography, learning from expert retouching provides a foundation for automatic aesthetic enhancement.
Datasets such as MIT-Adobe FiveK [ 2 ] and PPR10K [ 15 ] pair photographs with expert edits, making photographic aesthetic preferences available for learning.
Image enhancement methods learn these preferences through image-adaptive lookup tables (LUTs) [ 30 , 28 , 29 ] and color-aware tone curves [ 21 ] , adjusting color and tone based on image content to improve aesthetic presentation.
Users may also want to bring these aesthetic enhancements to 3D scenes.
blocks.zh:
在2D摄影中,从专家重修中学习为自动美学增强打下基础.
MIT-Adobe FiveK [2]和PPR10K [15]相片等数据集与专家编辑相配,使相片审美偏好可供学习.
图像增强方法通过图像适应取景表(LUT)[30,28,29]和有色感的调色曲线[21]来学习这些偏好,根据图像内容来调整颜色和调色来改进审美表现.
用户也可能希望将这些美学增强带入到3D场景.

blocks.en:
Several studies support 3D appearance editing guided by reference images or user input.
Reference-guided color transfer [ 24 , 26 ] propagates adjustments from a retouched view, and interactive editing [ 4 ] provides palette and luminance controls.
Similarly, reference-based stylization [ 12 , 33 ] transfers a chosen visual style.
However, users often seek a more visually appealing scene without having a reference image or a specific set of color adjustments in mind.
Meeting this need requires automatic, reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS assets, a task that existing work has not addressed.
blocks.zh:
一些研究支持由参考图像或用户输入指导的3D外观编辑.
参考指向颜色传输 [24,26] 从被重修的视图传播调整,交互编辑 [4] 提供调色板和发光控制.
同样地,基于参考的分型 [12,33] 转移了一个所选择的视觉风格.
然而,用户往往在不考虑参考图像或特定一组色彩调整的情况下,寻找一个更具视觉吸引力的场景.
满足这一需要,需要自动地,无参考的美学色彩增强预先训练过的3DGS资产,这是现有工作尚未解决的任务.

blocks.en:
Extending aesthetic enhancement to 3DGS presents three challenges.
First, image-adaptive enhancement applied independently to each view can produce different colors and tones [ 26 ] , requiring a consistent retouching decision for the whole scene.
Second, preserving the retouched appearance in the model for subsequent novel-view rendering requires faithfully encoding this decision in Gaussian color parameters.
However, the order of nonlinear color transformation and Gaussian blending affects the resulting pixel colors, so directly transforming each Gaussian’s color produces discrepancies with the target pixel colors.
Third, rendering-based editing [ 24 , 3 ] repeatedly renders the scene during per-scene optimization, adding substantial computation even for color adjustments.
Such optimization must also preserve the reconstructed geometry and view-dependent appearance to avoid structural or appearance artifacts.
These requirements motivate render-free color updates that preserve geometry and opacity.
blocks.zh:
将美学提升到3DGS提出了三个挑战.
首先,独立应用于每个视图的图像适应增强能产生出不同的颜色和色调[26],需要对整个场景做出一致的再调整决定.
其次,为后作小说-取景渲染而保留模型中被重修过的外观,需要忠实地将这一决定编码入高斯的色彩参数.
然而,非线性颜色转换和高斯混入的顺序会影响所形成的像素颜色,因此直接将每个高斯的颜色转换出与目标像素颜色产生差异.
第三,以渲染为主的编辑 [24,3] 反复使场景在每场景优化期间出场,即使为色彩调整也增加了实质性的计算.
这种优化还必须保留被重建的几何和取景外观,以避开结构或外观文物.
这些要求激发出保持几何和不透明的可渲染的色彩更新.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS assets, and it also supports reference-guided color transfer.
For reference-free enhancement, an aesthetic enhancement network learns from an image enhancer trained on expert-retouched photographs and predicts a scene-level LUT from the asset and its associated camera parameters.
The resulting RGB-to-RGB mapping is shared across viewpoints of the 3DGS scene.
For color transfer, we instead fit this mapping to a user-edited view and its corresponding original render.
Both tasks use a shared render-free color update stage that combines an analytic color update with learned color corrections from the blend-aware color refinement network, preserving geometry and opacity in a standard 3DGS asset.
The framework uses only 180.2K network parameters for reference-free enhancement and 44.7K for color transfer.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出ReTouchGS, 据我们所知,这是对预先训练的3DGS资产进行无参考美学色彩增强的第一个框架,它也支持有参考指导的色彩转移.
对于无参考增强,一个美学增强网络学习了通过专家取回相片培训的图像增强器,并从资产及其相机相关参数中预测出场景级LUT.
由此产生的RGB到RGB映射在3DGS场景的不同观点中共享.
为了进行色彩转换,我们把这张映射图配上用户编辑的视图及其相应的原始渲染.
这两项任务都采用了共享的渲染免费色彩更新阶段,将分析色彩更新与从混合-感知色彩完善网络中学到的色彩校正结合起来,在标准3DGS资产中保持几何和不透明.
框架仅使用180.2K网络参数来进行无参考增强,44.7K用于色调传输.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose ReTouchGS, the first framework, to our knowledge, for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS assets, with support for reference-guided color transfer. • We introduce the ReTouch3D benchmark with scene-consistent color targets and off-trajectory evaluation of retouching fidelity and cross-view generalization. • We develop a shared blend-aware color refinement network that refines analytic color updates to embed predicted or reference-fitted color mappings in standard Gaussian assets without rendering. Experiments show that ReTouchGS outperforms all evaluated baselines in color accuracy, PSNR, and LPIPS on both tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
2D Image Aesthetic Enhancement. Expert-retouched datasets [ 2 , 15 ] support learning aesthetic color and tonal adjustments for 2D photographs.
Image-adaptive 3D LUTs [ 30 ] represent these adjustments by combining learned basis tables.
AdaInt [ 28 ] adapts their color-space sampling, while SepLUT [ 29 ] separates channel-independent adjustments from channel interactions.
NamedCurves [ 21 ] learns tone curves for named colors and combines the adjusted images through attention.
These methods establish strong photographic retouching priors at the image level.
ReTouchGS brings the learned aesthetic decision to a pretrained 3DGS asset, predicting scene-wide colors and tones and embedding them in Gaussian colors for consistent novel-view rendering.
blocks.zh:
2D图像美学增强. 由专家检索的数据集 [2, 15] 支持2D相片的学习美学色彩和通体调整.

AdaInt [28] 调整了它们的颜色-空间采样,而SepLUT [29] 将频道-独立调整与频道互动分开.
命名为Curves [21] 为命名的颜色学习音色曲线,并通过注意来将调整后图像组合.
这些方法在图像层面建立了强烈的相片重修前科.

blocks.en:
3D Color Editing and Transfer. BilaRF [ 24 ] and Xiao et al. [ 26 ] propagate enhancement from an edited view to neural radiance fields and 3DGS, respectively.
IReNe [ 19 ] and VIRGi [ 20 ] support user-directed recoloring while preserving view-dependent effects, and ReparamGS [ 4 ] provides interactive palette and luminance controls.
Instant Colorization [ 16 ] and Support-Aware Appearance Distillation (SAAD) [ 3 ] fit Gaussian colors to edited targets through visibility-weighted least squares and spherical harmonic distillation, respectively.
FPGS [ 12 ] and StyleMe3D [ 33 ] transfer reference styles to Gaussian scenes, with StyleMe3D incorporating perceptual quality priors.
ViP3DE [ 5 ] uses video priors for multi-view consistent editing.
Rendering-based optimization methods, such as BilaRF [ 24 ] and SAAD [ 3 ] , repeatedly render the scene during editing, adding computational overhead even for color adjustments.
However, these methods require users to specify the target appearance through reference examples or interactive controls.
Luminance-GS [ 7 ] and LITA-GS [ 32 ] address reconstruction under challenging illumination, restoring scene appearance from degraded observations.
In contrast, ReTouchGS automatically determines how to improve a pretrained 3DGS scene’s existing colors based on aesthetic criteria without a reference, and efficiently realizes that decision through render-free color updates that preserve geometry and opacity.
The same LUT representation and color refinement network also support reference-guided color transfer.

IReNe [19]和VIRGi [20] 支持用户引导的再彩色,同时保留取景效果,ReparamGS [4]提供交互式调色板和发光控制.

基于渲染的优化方法,如BilarF [24]和SAAD [3],在编辑时反复使场景出场,甚至为色彩调整也增加了计算间接费用.

blocks.en: 3 ReTouch3D Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3个调试3D 基准

blocks.en:
Paired 3D scenes with view-consistent photographic retouching targets are scarce.
We construct ReTouch3D to support the evaluation of 3D aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer using scene-consistent targets derived from expert retouching priors ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh:
Paired 3D场景有与取景相符合的相片重塑目标,但十分稀少.
我们构建了ReTouch3D,以支持对3D美学色彩增强和参考指向色转移的评价,使用来自专家重修前科的符合场景目标(图2).

blocks.en:
The benchmark evaluates two tasks on 3D scenes: reference-free aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.
Reference-free aesthetic color enhancement takes a 3D asset 𝒢 s \mathcal{G}_{s} and its associated camera parameters 𝒞 s \mathcal{C}_{s} , including intrinsics and poses, and predicts aesthetically enhanced colors and tones using learned photographic retouching priors.
Reference-guided color transfer additionally receives one edited view of the same scene at reference viewpoint v 0 v_{0} , to specify the preferred colors and tones.
In both tasks, ReTouchGS outputs a retouched standard 3DGS asset whose novel views express the desired colors and tones.
The two tasks share the same target colors and tones, along with the evaluation views.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价议定书

blocks.en:
ReTouch3D contains 28 test scenes from DL3DV [ 17 ] and all nine from Mip-NeRF 360 [ 1 ] .

blocks.en: 4 Methodology - ReTouchGS
blocks.zh: 4 方法 - 重接电话

blocks.en:
ReTouchGS separates the choice of a scene’s colors and tones from their realization in Gaussian color parameters ( Figure 3 ).
Given an asset 𝒢 \mathcal{G} and its associated camera parameters 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , an aesthetic enhancement network predicts a scene-level color operator for reference-free enhancement.
For reference-guided color transfer, the operator is fitted to an edited view and its original render.
Both operators enter a shared render-free color update stage.
An analytic color update provides an initial transformation, and a blend-aware color refinement network predicts color corrections to produce an edited asset 𝒢 ′ \mathcal{G}^{\prime} .
This separation lets learned aesthetic preferences and user-specified colors and tones share one mechanism for consistent 3D retouching.

这种分离使得学会了审美偏好和用户指定颜色,和音量共享一个机制来进行一致的3D重修.

blocks.en:
Reference-Free Aesthetic Color Enhancement. Choosing an aesthetic adjustment requires both the spatial appearance of a scene and its overall color distribution.
Our aesthetic enhancement network E ϕ E_{\phi} obtains these complementary cues by projecting Gaussian centers into coarse image-plane projection grids.
It encodes view-dependent spherical harmonic (SH) colors, opacity, and relative scales, then pools features with opacity and depth weights.
A convolutional encoder summarizes the resulting spatial features, while RGB and luma quantiles describe the projected color and tonal distribution.
A feature encoder combines these cues at each viewpoint, and mean pooling across viewpoints forms one scene descriptor.

Reference-Guided Color Transfer. An edited view specifies the creator’s preferred colors and tones through corresponding original and target colors.
The original asset is rendered once from the reference viewpoint, and a grid LUT is fitted to the paired original and edited RGB values.
An identity-centered ridge penalty anchors colors sparsely represented in the reference, allowing one edited view to specify a scene-level mapping.
The fitted LUT enters the shared render-free color update stage.
The fitting objective and solver settings are specified in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.2 Blended Color Context and Analytic Color Update
blocks.zh: 4.2 混合颜色背景和分析颜色更新

blocks.en:
With geometry and opacity fixed, rendered pixels combine contributions from several Gaussians.
However, applying a nonlinear operator to this mixture differs from mixing individually transformed colors.
Therefore, each Gaussian’s update should account for the colors it contributes to forming.
The blended color context m i m_{i} is estimated by pooling view-dependent SH colors in coarse projection grids with opacity and soft depth weights, then aggregating the grid colors at Gaussian i i ’s projections across viewpoints.
This supplies a color around which to approximate the input color transformation using asset attributes and camera projections.

blocks.en: 4.4 Training Strategy and Objectives

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Color Update Components. As shown in Table 2 , with the grid LUT fixed, accounting for blended color context improves over direct per-Gaussian transformation, and learned refinement further improves every test scene in reference-guided transfer.

blocks.en: 5.4 Adaptation to Different Retouching Targets
blocks.zh: 5.4 适应不同的调整目标

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether learned color refinement transfers to a new source of photographic adjustments, we use VeraRetouch [ 8 ] to construct targets for both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer on all 37 scenes in ReTouch3D.
The color refinement network was trained without color adjustments generated by VeraRetouch, and its weights remain fixed throughout these experiments.
For aesthetic enhancement, we retrain the aesthetic enhancement network using VeraRetouch-derived labels while keeping the pretrained color refinement network fixed.
For reference-guided transfer, we fit the grid LUT to the edited reference and apply the same fixed refinement network. Table 3 shows that ReTouchGS achieves the lowest color error and LPIPS and the highest PSNR and SSIM among the compared methods in both tasks.
These results demonstrate that ReTouchGS adapts effectively to color adjustment labels from different retouching models while retaining a shared, fixed color refinement network, achieving higher fidelity than the compared methods in both tasks.
Target construction details are in Appendix C .

色彩精炼网络是在没有由Vera Retouch所产生颜色调整的情况下被训练出来的,其重量在这些实验中始终固定不变.
为了增强美学,我们利用Vera Retouch衍生的标签对美学增强网络进行再培训,同时保持预训色彩精炼网络的固定.
为了进行参考引导传输,我们把网格LUT与被编辑的参考相匹配,并应用同样的固定的精细网络. 表3显示,ReTouchGS在两个任务的比较方法中实现了最小的颜色差错和LPIPS以及最高的PSNR和SSIM.
这些结果显示,ReTouchGS在保留共享的固定的色彩精炼网络的同时,有效地适应了不同重修模型的色彩调整标签,实现了高于两个任务中比较方法的忠诚.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ReTouchGS, an ultralight framework for aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer of pretrained 3DGS assets.
Our ReTouch3D benchmark enables evaluation against scene-consistent color targets across viewpoints.
Experiments show that ReTouchGS achieves lower color error than competing methods, supports efficient editing, and generalizes across viewpoints, color operators, and photographic retouching priors.
These results enable practical photographic retouching of 3D assets, combining automatic aesthetic decisions with user control and geometry-preserving standard 3DGS outputs.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了ReTouchGS, 一个超光灯框架,用于美学色彩增强和参考指导色转移 预训练的3DGS资产。
我们的回转3 D基准能够对不同观点的场景一致的颜色目标进行评价。
实验显示,ReTouchGS比相竞方法实现更低的色彩误差,支持高效的编辑,并概括跨视线,色彩操作员,相片重修前科.
这些结果使得能对3D资产进行实际的相片再加工,将自动审美决定与用户控制和几何保存标准3DGS输出相结合.

blocks.en:
Training Data. The aesthetic enhancement network uses 189 DL3DV [ 17 ] training scenes and 23 validation scenes.
Of the 189 training scenes, 145 supply the LUTs used to train the blend-aware color refinement network.
Training, validation, and test scenes are disjoint.
The blend-aware color refinement network uses 16 complete assets from this 145-scene subset and six validation assets, selected with seed zero.
Training and validation assets contain at most 800,000 and 1,000,000 Gaussians, respectively.
Each selected asset contributes all its Gaussians.

训练,鉴定,试验场景脱节.
混合意识色彩精炼网络使用从这145色子集中取出16个完整资产和6个验证资产,选取出种子为零.
培训和验证资产分别最多80万和100万高斯人。
每个被选中的资产贡献出其所有的高斯人.

blocks.en:
The refinement operator bank contains 580 LUTs from these 145 scenes and four pretrained enhancers: the MIT5K-DPE, PPR10K-C, and MIT5K-UEGAN variants of NamedCurves [ 21 ] , and the sRGB model of image-adaptive 3D LUT [ 30 ] .
Each scene-level LUT is fitted to 36 enhanced views using Section A.2 .
The aesthetic enhancement network learns the MIT5K-DPE targets.

Enhancement Supervision. The color bank 𝒳 s \mathcal{X}_{s} in Eq. 8 contains 131,072 quantized colors per scene, sampled from pairs of Gaussians and viewpoints with replacement and probabilities proportional to F i ​ v F_{iv} .
Pairs are drawn from the selected Gaussian set and the 20 input viewpoints. Each entry stores the view-dependent SH color of its sampled pair, clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and quantized with Q 8 Q_{8} .
The color bank remains fixed throughout training.
Each enhancement step samples four scenes with replacement and four to eight input viewpoints per scene.
For each scene, the viewpoint count is sampled uniformly, and a random permutation selects the viewpoints.
Each scene contributes 65,536 bank entries sampled with replacement per step.
The enhancement loss averages absolute error over colors and RGB channels, including the 1 / 3 1/3 factor in the main text.
Inference averages the representations from all 20 input viewpoints.

Operator Sampling and Refinement Training. During rendering fine-tuning, we sample the identity color operator with probability 0.1 0.1 .
Otherwise, we uniformly sample a bank LUT and interpolate it with another uniformly sampled bank LUT with probability 0.5 0.5 , using a coefficient sampled from U ⁡ [ 0 , 1 ] U[0,1] .
The resulting displacements are scaled by U ⁡ [ 0.5 , 1.5 ] U[0.5,1.5] .
Solver demonstrations use non-identity operators drawn with the same interpolation and scaling procedure and a fixed seed per scene.
Each training asset supplies 24 non-identity demonstrations, giving 384 scene-operator pairs, and each validation asset supplies eight.
The solver and visibility weights for distillation are specified in Section B.4 .

Rendering fine-tuning uses one scene, one operator, and two views per update, rendered at a width of 480 pixels.

Perturbations use the local-axis and translation-direction construction in Section A.3 , with training ranges U ⁡ [ 0 ∘ , 20 ∘ ] U[0^{\circ},20^{\circ}] for rotation and U ⁡ [ 0 , 0.075 ​ r s ] U[0,0.075r_{s}] for translation length.
The image loss averages over sampled views, pixels, and RGB channels.
The correction penalty uses λ corr = 10 − 3 \lambda_{\mathrm{corr}}=10^{-3} and averages squared corrections over Gaussians and RGB.
blocks.zh:
两个改进阶段都统一抽取一个场景,每四个更新一次,再用于这些更新。
在每次更新时均统一演示一个解析器样本。
渲染微调会用上面的采样器绘制出一个新的操作员.
渲染微调使用一个场景,一个操作员,以及每个更新时的两个视图,所渲染的宽度为480像素.
每个视图使用输入相机摆出概率为0.3 0.3的相机,或扰动相机摆出其他相机.

blocks.en:
Optimization and Model Selection. All stages use AdamW [ 18 ] , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , OneCycle [ 23 ] scheduling with 5% warm-up, and gradient-norm clipping at one.
Network initialization and training-time sampling use seed zero.
Aesthetic enhancement, solver distillation, and rendering fine-tuning use 20,000, 16,000, and 12,000 updates, with peak learning rates of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , respectively.
Each stage starts a new optimizer and schedule.
We select the aesthetic enhancement network by mean validation image-space Δ ​ E 76 \Delta E_{76} after 5,000, 10,000, and 20,000 training updates.
Validation applies the predicted and target LUTs to 20 input views per scene at width 240 and selects the model trained for 20,000 updates.
Our implementation uses Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.11.0 with CUDA 12.8, and gsplat 1.5.3.
blocks.zh:
优化与模式选择. 所有阶段都使用 AdamW [18],重量衰变 10 - 4 10 - Q 4}, OneCycle [23] 排行表,加热5%,梯度-规范剪接一个.
网络初始化和培训时间采样使用种子零.
美学增强,解析器分馏,并作微调利用了20,000,16,000,和12,000个更新,峰值学习率分别是:3×10−4 3\times 10×4}10×3 10×3 10×3}和3×10×4 3\times 10×4}.
每个阶段开始一个新的优化器和时间表.
我们通过平均验证图像空间来选择美学增强网络。
校验将预测的并瞄准的LUT应用到每个场景的20个输入视图中,宽度240,并选择训练出来的模型进行20,000个更新.
我们的执行使用Python 3.10、PyTorch 2.11.0和CUDA 12.8以及gsplat 1.5.3。

blocks.en: C.2 Inputs and Output Representations
blocks.zh: C.2 投入和产出说明

blocks.en:
All asset comparisons start from the same source assets and follow the same benchmark viewpoint protocol.
In aesthetic enhancement, image-conditioned baselines obtain their targets by applying NamedCurves MIT5K-DPE [ 21 ] to input views.
Instant Colorization, BilaRF, ReparamGS, FPGS, VIRGi, ViP3DE, and Omni-3DEdit receive one enhanced view, while SAAD receives sixteen.
FPGS and ViP3DE also read twenty original input-view renders.
ReparamGS and VIRGi use original renders for scene preparation, as detailed below.
These preparation views are separate from the enhanced target images used to supervise editing.
VCG is evaluated as an alternative LUT source in Section C.5 .
In reference-guided color transfer, each method receives the same edited image at v 0 v_{0} .
The reference image supplies the intended color appearance for the entire scene.
blocks.zh:
所有资产比较都从同一来源资产开始,并遵循相同的基准观点协议。
在美学增强中,以图像为条件的基线通过将命名的Curves MIT5K-DPE [21] 应用到输入视图中来获得目标.
即时取色,BilaRF,ReparamGS,FPGS,VIRGi,ViP3DE,和Omni-3Dedit获得一个增强视图,而SAAD则获得16个.
FPGS和ViP3DE还读取了20个原始输入视图。
ReparamGS和VIRGi在现场准备中使用了原件,详情如下。
这些准备视图与用于监督编辑的增强目标图像是分开的.
在C.5节中,VCG被评价为LUT的替代来源.
在参考指向颜色传输中,每一种方法在v 0 v_{0} 接收相同的被编辑的图像.
参考图像为整个场景提供了预定的颜色外观.

blocks.en:
We evaluate each method’s native output.
Standard 3DGS assets use the common 3DGS renderer.
BilaRF preserves its bilateral grid, ReparamGS preserves palette-weight SH and tone controls, and VIRGi preserves its neural color representation.
Omni-3DEdit produces edited images.
blocks.zh:
我们评价每种方法的本地输出。
标准3DGS资产使用通用的3DGS渲染器.
BilARF保留了它的双边网格,ReparamGS保留了调色器重量的SH和调色控制,而VIRGi则保留了它的神经颜色代表.
Omni-3Dedit 生成已编辑的图像 。

blocks.en: C.3 Asset Editing Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 资产编辑基线

blocks.en:
Instant Colorization. Instant Colorization [ 16 ] uses the authors’ color-statistics collection, visibility normalization, linear solve, and CUDA rasterizer.
We provide the input Gaussian geometry and registered camera parameters, then perform the initial solve and fifty refinements from one edited view.
The SH regularization weights are 10 − 5 10^{-5} for DC and 10 − 2 10^{-2} for each higher order.
Each per-Gaussian system uses a direct linear solve.
The output is a standard 3DGS asset.
blocks.zh:
即时入色相. 即时取色 [16] 使用作者所收集的取色统计,能见度正常化,线性解,和CUDA光栅.
我们提供了输入高斯几何学和已注册相机参数,然后从一个编辑的视图中执行初始解析和50个改进.
DC的SH规范权重为10 - 5 10 - 5 ; DC的规范权重为10 - 2 10 - 2 。
每个每加西系统都使用直线解.
输出为标准3DGS资产.

blocks.en:
BilaRF. We couple the authors’ CP-factorized 4D bilateral grid [ 24 ] to the input 3DGS asset to adjust colors using 3D position and learned grayscale guidance.
The grid uses spatial resolution 16 3 16^{3} , eight bins along the guidance dimension, factorization rank five, and a spatial coordinate bound of one.
Its learned grayscale guidance network has width eight and depth two.
Optimization uses Adam [ 13 ] for 2,500 updates, with learning rate decaying exponentially from 10 − 2 10^{-2} to 10 − 3 10^{-3} , betas ( 0.9 , 0.99 ) (0.9,0.99) , and ϵ = 10 − 15 \epsilon=10^{-15} .
The objective combines mean Charbonnier error e 2 + 10 − 6 \sqrt{e^{2}+10^{-6}} and the authors’ total-variation term with unit weight.
Positions are normalized by the center and radius of the reconstruction camera distribution, and full-frame supervision replaces random-ray batches.
blocks.zh:
毕拉福 我们把作者的由CP构成的 4D 双边网格[24] 与输入 3DGS 资产对等,以便使用 3D 位置来调整颜色,并学习出灰度指导。
网格使用空间分辨率 16 3 16^{3}, 沿向导维度有8个宾箱,因子化等级为5等,空间坐标约束为1等.
它所学的灰色尺度制导网络有宽度8和深度2.
优化使用亚当[13]进行2500个更新,学习速率衰变指数从10−2 10−2}到10−3 10−3 10−3},β (0.9,0.99) (0.9,0.99),和QQ = 10−15\epsilon=10−15}.
目标结合了Charbonnier error e + 10 − 6\sqrt{e^{2}+10^{-6}}和作者以单位重量的总变相词.
位置由重建相机分布的中和半径实现常态化,全帧监督取代了随机光分批.

blocks.en:
SAAD. Our implementation of SAAD [ 3 ] keeps geometry and opacity fixed and learns scene-specific appearance predictors for illumination, tone, and detail.
Adam runs for 5,000 updates at learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
The predictors use two hidden ReLU layers, widths 64 for illumination and tone and 32 for detail, four Fourier bands, and degree-three SH.
Gaussian filters use kernel size and standard deviation ( 21 , 5 ) (21,5) and ( 7 , 1.5 ) (7,1.5) .
Aesthetic enhancement supplies sixteen evenly spaced enhanced views from the input set, while reference-guided color transfer supplies one edited supervision view.
For numerical settings unspecified by the paper, we activate the illumination and detail branches after steps 1,000 and 3,000, respectively.
The Gaussian-level auxiliary loss has weight one before the first transition and 0.1 0.1 afterwards. The quantile threshold for selecting detail-supervision pixels decreases from 0.95 0.95 to 0.70 0.70 after the second transition.
The temperature controlling residual agreement across supervision views is 0.01 0.01 , and DC-magnitude, direction, and higher-order-SH penalties each have weight 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
Tone statistics use global and 4 × 4 4\times 4 patch means and population standard deviations in BT.601 YUV.
The loss sums over pixels and supervision views, accumulating gradients from all supervision views before each update.
blocks.zh:
萨达。 我们实施SAAD[3]保持了几何和不透明度的固定,并学习了场景特有外观预测器来进行照明,调子和细节.
Adam以学习率10 - 3 10 - 3 3 = 5 000 更新。
预测器使用两个隐藏的ReLU地层,宽度64来表示发光和发音,32来表示细节,4个傅里叶波段,和三级SH.
高斯滤波器使用内核大小和标准偏差(21,5) (21,5)和(7,1.5) (7,1.5).
美学增强能提供16个均匀间距的从输入集中增强的视图,而参考指向的色彩传输能提供一个经过编辑的监督视图.
对于纸张未说明的数字设置,我们分别激活了1000和3000步后发光和细枝.
高斯级辅助损耗在第一次过渡前有重量一分,后为0.1克. 选取细节-超视像素的分数阈值从第二次过渡后的0.95 0.95降至0.70 0.70.
整个监督角度的温度控制残留协议为0.010.01,DC-宽度、方向和高级SH处罚各有重量10 - 4 10-Q-4}。
通量统计使用全局和4×4 4\times 4补丁手段和BT.601 YUV中的人口标准差.
损失金额超过像素和监督视图,在每次更新前从所有监督视图中积累梯度。

blocks.en:
ReparamGS. The authors’ palette decomposition and constraint solver [ 4 ] prepare the asset for ten epochs using original renders from the reconstruction viewpoints, excluding the sixteen held-out viewpoints.
Seed 42 initializes four evenly spaced chromatic palette colors, black and white, and degree-three palette-weight SH.
Adam learning rates are 0.005 0.005 for DC weights, 0.0005 0.0005 for higher orders, and 0.01 0.01 for palette parameters.
The decomposition combines barycentric MSE, positivity with weight 0.5 0.5 , compactness increasing from 0.001 0.001 to 0.005 0.005 , and unit-weight hue separation with minimum gap 0.3 0.3 .
Editing uses 100 reference pixels on a fixed 10 × 10 10\times 10 grid.
The constraint solver adjusts palette colors and tone curves using damped block coordinate descent (dBCD) with iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS).
It performs up to eight outer rounds with damping 0.7 0.7 , 100 curve samples, constraint weight w eq = 1,000 w_{\mathrm{eq}}=1{,}000 , palette-shift weight w sp = 0.1 w_{\mathrm{sp}}=0.1 within the sparsity term, ρ = 100 \rho=100 , and eight inner iterations with ϵ = 0.001 \epsilon=0.001 .
The delivered representation preserves the palette and tone controls.
blocks.zh:
复还金刚. 作者的调色板分解和约束解决器[4] 利用重建观点的原始出品为10个时代准备资产,不包括16个搁置的观点。
种子42初始化了四种均匀相间色相调色板颜色,黑白相间的相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相间相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
亚当的学习率是DC重量为0.0050.005分,较高订单为0.0005分,调色板参数为0.01分.
分解结合了以巴氏为核心的MSE,正态为重0.5 0.5,紧凑度从0.001 0.001提高到0.005 0.005,单位-重量相分离,最小相差0.3 0.3。
编辑使用100个参考像素在一个固定的10×10\times 10网格上.
约束解码器会使用被坝块坐标下降(dBCD)来调整调色板颜色和调色曲线,并带有迭代重压最小平方(IRLS).
它最多执行8发外弹,以0.7分,100分曲线样品,约束重量w eq = 1000 w_{\ mathrm{eq{{{{{}000,调色板-相变重量w sp = 0.1 w_{\ mathrm{sp}}=0.1 在斯帕氏语术语中, ρ = 100\rho=100, 8个内迭相以 ε = 0.001\epsilon=0.001.
交付的表示保留了调色板和调子控制.

blocks.en:
FPGS. FPGS [ 12 ] follows the authors’ preprocessing, feature-autoencoder training, Gaussian reconstruction, and style-transfer procedure.
Twenty input-view renders provide the source images, and the input Gaussian centers and DC colors initialize the point cloud.
DINO features use resolution 448, overlapping 113 × 113 113\times 113 grids, horizontal-flip averaging, and guided filtering.
The autoencoder trains for five epochs with Adam at 0.001 0.001 .
Scene reconstruction uses 30,000 updates with RGB L 1 L_{1} and DSSIM, adding semantic L 1 L_{1} with weight 0.1 0.1 after step 25,000.
Native densification and opacity resets are preserved.
Style transfer uses two passes, temperature 100, ϵ = 0.01 \epsilon=0.01 , and blending 0.3 0.3 .
We evaluate the resulting native 3DGS asset.
blocks.zh:
FPGS. FPGS [12] 遵循作者的预处理、特征自动编码器培训、高斯重建以及风格转换程序。
20个输入视图提供源图像,输入高斯中枢和DC颜色初始化点云.
DINO特性使用分辨率为448,重叠为113×113113\times 113网格,水平-平滑平均,并有导滤.
5个世纪的自动编码列车 亚当在0.001 001.
场景重建使用与RGB L 1 L_{1}和DSSIM的3万个更新,添加了语义L 1 L_{1},分量为0.1分后为2.5万步.
原生密度和不透明度的再现被保留.
风格传出使用两个通路,温度100,QQ=0.01\epsilon=0.01,并混合0.30.3.
我们评价3DGS的本土资产。

blocks.en:
VIRGi. Our implementation of VIRGi [ 20 ] uses three-layer diffuse and specular networks of width 64, unidirectional hidden-feature connections, and a sigmoid on their summed output.
The hash grid has sixteen levels with two features per level, base resolution 16, scale 1.447, and hash-table size 2 19 2^{19} .
Directions use nine degree-two SH coefficients.
Preparation uses 30,000 Adam updates at learning rate 0.01 0.01 , with 100 warm-up steps and learning-rate multipliers 0.33 0.33 at steps 5,000, 15,000, and 25,000.
Each batch contains 32 groups of image patches, each grouping five 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches that observe the same Gaussian from different viewpoints.
The specular penalty decreases from 0.25 0.25 to 0.05 0.05 .
Editing updates a copy of the final diffuse layer and a soft-segmentation network for 200 steps at 0.01 0.01 .
The segmentation network predicts weights that blend the original and edited diffuse colors.
Segmentation and editing settings follow IReNe [ 19 ] .
Original-asset renders supervise preparation, and the native neural representation is evaluated with the source geometry and opacity.
blocks.zh:
维来吉. 我们实施VIRGi [20] 使用宽度64的三层扩散和光谱网络,单向隐形地层连接,以及其总输出上的相模.
散列网有16个关卡,每个关卡有两个特征,基分辨度为16分,比分为1.447分,而散列表大小为2分19分2分19分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分15分.
方向使用9等-2SH系数.
准备用途 亚当以0.01 0.01的学习速率更新,分出100个取暖步骤和学习速率乘以0.33 0.33分,分出5000分,15000分,分出25000分.
每批包含32组图像补丁,每组组合5个从不同角度观察同高斯人的16×16相16相16补丁.
分级处罚从0.250.25降至0.050.05。
编辑更新了最后扩散层和200个步骤的软分层网络,时间为0.01 0.01。
分块网络预测能将原色和被编辑的散色混合在一起的权重.
分会和编辑设置遵循 IReNe [19].
原始资产进行监督准备,用源几何和不透明来评价原生神经特征。

blocks.en: C.4 Image Propagation Baselines
blocks.zh: C.4 图像传播基线

blocks.en:
Omni-3DEdit. Omni-3DEdit [ 6 ] uses the authors’ appearance model trained for 4,000 updates and inference seed 23.
For both tasks, the image-propagation pipeline receives the original/edited reference pair and sixteen off-trajectory source renders, processed in two nine-view batches with repeated views filling the final batch.
VGGT-1B estimates poses from these images.
blocks.zh:
Omni-3Dedit. Omni-3Dedit [6] 使用作者的外观模型训练出4000个更新和推断出种23.
对于这两项任务,图像传播管道收到原始/编辑的参考对和16个离线源制成的,分两批九景处理,再三观察,填充最后一批。
VGGT-1B估计来自这些图像.

blocks.en:
ViP3DE. ViP3DE [ 5 ] uses the authors’ custom-edit configuration.
Twenty input-view renders are ordered along the capture trajectory with the reference first.
For reference-guided color transfer, the supplied edited reference replaces the first-frame InstructPix2Pix edit.
For aesthetic enhancement, this interface receives the output of NamedCurves on the first input view.
The remaining pipeline is shared across tasks.
SVD inversion and propagation use 25 steps, inversion strength 0.15 0.15 , and internal resolution 576 × 1024 576\times 1024 .
Asset fitting runs 600 Adam updates at 0.001 0.001 , with betas ( 0.9 , 0.99 ) (0.9,0.99) , ϵ = 10 − 15 \epsilon=10^{-15} , seed zero, and weights ten for both L 1 L_{1} and perceptual losses.
The native pruning and densification procedure is preserved.
The input interface preserves the benchmark image dimensions and field of view, and evaluation uses the delivered 3DGS asset.
blocks.zh:
ViP3DE. ViP3DE [5] 使用作者自定义编辑配置.
20个输入视图按捕获轨迹顺序排列,并首先使用参考文献。
对于参考指向颜色传输,所提供被编辑的参考取代了第一个框架InstructPix2Pix编辑.
为了增强美学,这个接口接收了NatedCurves在第一个输入视图上的输出.
其余的管道由各种任务分担。
SVD倒置和传播使用25个步骤,倒置强度为0.15 0.15,内部分辨率为576×1024 576\times 1024.
资产配置运行600 Adam更新 0.001 00:00, 有βs (0.9, 0.99) (0.9, 0.99), = 10 − 15 \ epsilon = 10 + 15 }, 种子为0; 重量为10, 两者均为L 1 L_{ 1 ) 和 感官损失.
保留了本土的收发和收发程序。
输入界面保留了基准图像维度和视野,评价使用交付的3DGS资产.

blocks.en: C.5 LUT Configurations and Retouching Priors
blocks.zh: C.5. 纬度 配置和校正前科

blocks.en:
Alternative LUT Representation: GLUT. To evaluate a continuous LUT representation for reference-guided color transfer, we replace the default grid LUT with the authors’ single-LUT representation of GLUT [ 27 ] , fitted to the same original/edited reference pair.
It uses 32 color-space Gaussians and 716 trainable parameters, with residual connection and normalized Gaussian blending.
Adam trains for twenty epochs at learning rate 0.001 0.001 , batch size 4,096, and seed 52, with cosine scheduling at every update and gradient clipping at one.
The objective combines RGB L 1 L_{1} , target-chroma-weighted hue loss with weight ten, and opacity entropy with weight 0.001 0.001 .
Following the official GLUT fitting procedure, we progressively emphasize color pairs with larger prediction errors and reuse previously selected hard samples during optimization.
GLUT fits all reference pixels, whereas the grid LUT uses the sampled ridge fit in Section B.1 .
Both operators use the same blended color context, analytic color update, and trained blend-aware color refinement network. Table 9 compares the two LUT representations in operator accuracy and edited-asset fidelity.
blocks.zh:
备选案文LUT 代表人物:GLUT. 为了评价一个持续的LUT代表来进行参考制导的颜色传输,我们用作者的单-LUT代表GLUT[27]取代了默认的网格LUT,并配以同一正本/编辑的参考对.
它使用32个色相空间高斯人和716个可被训练参数,并有剩余连接和使高斯人相融合正常化.
亚当列车为20个世纪的列车,学习速度为0.001 001,批量大小为4 096,种子为52,每次更新时均采用同心电图排出,梯度剪接一次.
目标结合了RGB L 1 LQQQ1},目标-色素加权色素减重为10分,不透明 en重为0.001分.
按照正式的GLUT装配程序,我们逐渐强调带有较大预测误差的相色配对,并在优化时再利用以前选定的硬样品.
GLUT 符合所有参考像素,而网格LUT 则使用B.1节所取取取取取取的脊.
两家运营商都使用同一种混合颜色上下文,分析色彩更新,以及训练有素的混合-意识色彩完善网络. 表9比较了两个LUT表示的操作者准确性和经编辑的资产忠诚性。

blocks.en:
Video Color Grading. Video Color Grading (VCG) [ 22 ] provides an alternative source of scene-level LUTs using the authors’ pretrained GS-Extractor and L-Diffuser.
It processes twenty original input-view frames and one edited reference with 25 DDIM steps and seed 48.
The edited reference corresponds to the first input viewpoint.
Its native 16 3 16^{3} LUT is sampled on a 17 3 17^{3} grid and combined with the analytic color update for asset evaluation. Table 10 compares this LUT source with the default grid-LUT configurations in both tasks.
blocks.zh:

Lower temporal residual indicates more consistent target-relative color errors across views.

blocks.en: E.6 Rendering Requirements

blocks.en:
We compare rendering requirements during asset preparation and editing.
Starting from a pretrained 3DGS asset, image-conditioned enhancement baselines render source views to construct their targets.
BilaRF [ 24 ] , SAAD [ 3 ] , and Instant Colorization [ 16 ] also use rendered supervision during editing. ReparamGS [ 4 ] , FPGS [ 12 ] , and VIRGi [ 20 ] render views for scene-specific preparation.
ViP3DE [ 5 ] and Omni-3DEdit [ 6 ] propagate edits through source images, while VCG [ 22 ] uses an input-view sequence to predict its LUT.
In contrast, ReTouchGS predicts the scene-level color operator with its aesthetic enhancement network and applies the render-free color update directly to the asset.
Reference-guided color transfer renders the original reference view once for paired operator fitting, followed by the same render-free color update.
